description: This file defines a utility object 'SplitUtils' that provides methods to split a string into tokens based on spaces and store the tokens in a LinkedList.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utility functions.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces and returns them in a LinkedList.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation criteria.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (not empty).
